ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels vs 15% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white zone across the central fluke surface. Low-intensity black margins along the trailing edges. Isolated circular dark clusters (mottling) distributed across the mid-section of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex convergence and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right lobe (viewer perspective) exhibits high-frequency, high-amplitude saw-tooth serrations with multiple sharp peaks. The left lobe exhibits lower-frequency, shallower edge irregularities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted from the median notch extending towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular dark pixel clusters (diameter 5-15 pixels) scattered across the high-intensity fields of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine vertical low-intensity linear streaks visible on the lower-right quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Brown-toned textured protrusion on the right-most lateral tip consistent with external colonization; jagged, irregular contour disruptions on the right trailing edge suggesting historical physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in serration amplitude and frequency between the left and right lobe trailing edges.
